cohort: 250 pregnant women diagnosed with SARS-CoV-2 (Case group) and 300 healthy pregnant women (Control group) in Mosul from February 20 to October 20, 2021.
finding: There were no significant differences in fetal growth velocity or Doppler readings between pregnant women with and without SARS-CoV-2 infection, but there was a higher incidence of cesarean delivery and lower fetal activity at birth in the SARS-CoV-2 group.
gest_age: Ultrasound exams were done from 24 to 40 weeks gestation.
birth_weight: Estimated fetal weight was measured every four weeks.
